message: When the lights went out last weekend, our family group chat lit up brighter than any flashlight. My sister sent a meme about how we’d all survive on snacks, while my mom was busy sharing her favorite lantern hacks. We ended up laughing through the darkness, trading tips and silly stories to keep spirits high. It reminded me that even in a blackout, staying connected makes all the difference. How do you keep the fun alive during unexpected outages?
